यकृत् [cf. Gk. ἧπαρ; Lat. jecur.]
a: यकृत् — n. [यंसंयमं करोति कृ क्विप् तुक् च Tv.] The liver or any affection of it. --Comp. --आत्मिका a kind of cock-roach. --उदरं enlargement of the liver. --कोषः the membrane enveloping the liver.

k.v: अन्त्रं पुरीतद्गुल्मस्तु प्लीहा पुंस्यथ वस्नसा। स्नायुः स्त्रियां कालखण्डयकृती तु समे इमे॥

m: यक्ष n. a living supernatural being, spiritual apparition, ghost, spirit, RV.; AV.; VS.; Br.; GṛŚrS. (accord. to some native Comms. = यज्ञ, पुजा, पूजित &c.)

यक्ष m. N. of a class of semi-divine beings (attendants of Kubera, exceptionally also of Viṣṇu; described as sons of Pulastya, of Pulaha, of Kaśyapa, of Khasā or Krodhā; also as produced from the feet of Brahmā; though generally regarded as beings of a benevolent and inoffensive disposition, like the Yakṣa in Kālidāsa's Megha-dūta, they are occasionally classed with Piśācas and other malignant spirits, and sometimes said to cause demoniacal possession; as to their position in the Buddhist system See MWB. 206, 218), Up.; GṛS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
(with Jainas) a subdivision of the Vyantaras
N. of Kubera, VarYogay.
of a Muni, R.
of a son of Śvaphalka, VP.
of Indra's palace, L.
a dog, L.
a: यक्षः — [यक्ष्यते, यक्ष्-कर्मणि घञ्] 1 N. of a class of demigods who are described as attendants of Kubera, the god of riches, and employed in guarding his gardens and treasures; यक्षोत्तमा यक्षपतिं धनेशं रक्षंति वै प्रासगदादिहस्ताः Hariv., Me. 1, 66; Bg. 10. 23, 11. 22. --2 A kind of ghost or spirit. --3 N. of the palace of Indra. --4 N. of Kubera. --5 Worship. --क्षं 1 A ghost, --2 Sacrifice. --3 Anything honoured. --क्षी 1 A female Yakṣa. --2 N. of Kubera's wife. --Comp. --अधिपः. --अधिपतिः, --इंद्रः Kubera, the lord of Yakṣas. --आमलकं the fruit of the पिंडखर्जूर tree. --आवासः the fig-tree. --कर्दमः an ointment consisting of camphor, agallochum, musk and Kakkola (according to others, also sandal and saffron) mixed in equal proportions; (कर्पूरागृरुकस्तूरीकक्कोलैर्यक्षकर्दमः Ak.; कुकुमागुरुकस्तूरी कर्पूरं चदनं तथा . महासु गंधमित्युक्तं नामतो यक्षकर्दमः ..). --ग्रहः the being possessed by Yakṣas or evil spirits. --तरुः the fig-tree. --धूपः resin, incense. --रसः a kind of intoxicating drink. --राज् m. N. of Kubera. {2} a place prepared for wrestling and boxing. --राजः N. of Kubera. --रात्रिः f. the festival called Dīpālī. q. v. --वित्तः one who is like a Yakṣa, i. e. the guardian of wealth, but who never uses it.

यक्ष—वित्त mfn. one whose property is like that of the Y˚s, one who has merely the guardianship of property and does not make use of it himself, BhP.
यक्षेश् m. N. of the servants of the 11th and 18th Arhat of the present Avasarpiṇī, L.
यक्षेश m. = next, W.
यक्षेश्वर m. a king of the Y˚s Megh.
N. of Kubera, Hit.
यक्षेश्वर—मेधीय n. N. of wk.
यक्षेन्द्र m. a king of the Y˚s R.; MārkP.
N. of Kubera, MBh.; R.

s: strI, (yakzaH pUjA astyasyAH । yakza + iniH । NIp .) kuberapatnI । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ yakzaBAryyA ca ॥ (yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 10 । 178 । “so'pi muktvASu vijane BrAtuH putraM tamaByaDAt । aDftiM mA kfTAH putra ! mama sidDA hi yakziRI ॥”)
m: यक्षिणी f. of यक्षिन्
a female Yakṣa, MBh.; R. &c.
Kubera's wife, L.
a sort of female demon or fiend (attached to the service of Durgā and frequently, like a sylph or fairy, maintaining intercourse with mortals), W.
यक्षिणी f. See above.
a: यक्षिणी — 1 A female Yakṣa. --2 N of the wife of Kubera. --3 A certain female fiend in the service of Durgā. --4 A sylph or fairy (holding intercourse with mortals).

यक्षिणी—पटल m. or n. (?) N. of wk.
यक्षिणी—साधन n. N. of wk.
यक्षिणी—तन्त्र n. N. of wk.
यक्षिणी—त्व n. the state or condition of a female Y˚, Kathās.
यक्षिणी—वेताल-साधन n. N. of wk.
यक्षिन् mfn. having life, living, really existing (accord. to Sāy. = पूजनीय), RV.
a: यक्षिन् — a. Ved. 1 Living, existing. --2 Adorable, fit to be honoured.

rAjayakzmakzayaSozAH ॥ * ॥ yakzmAdInAM SabdAnAM niruktimAha । ‘vEdyo vyADimatAM yasmAt vyADeryatnena yakzyate । sa yakzmA procyate loke SabdaSAstraviSAradEH ॥’ yakzyate pUjyate । ‘rAjYaScandramaso yasmAdaBUdeza kilAmayaH । tasmAttaM rAjayakzmeti kecidAhurmanIziRaH ॥ kriyAkzayakaratvAttu kzaya ityucyate buDEH । saMSozaRAdrasAdInAM Soza ityaBiDIyate ॥’ * ॥ saMprAptimAha । ‘kaPapraDAnErdozEstu rudDezu rasavartmasu । ativyavAyino vApi kzIRe retasyanantarA । kzIyante DAtavaH sarvve tataH Suzyati mAnavaH ॥’ kaPapraDAnErddozEH rasavartmasu rudDezu anantarA sarvve DAtavaH kzIyante tato mAnavaH Suzyati । kAraRaBUtasya rasasya kzaye kAryyARAM raktAdInAmanukrameRa kzIyamARatvAt ॥ * ॥ mArgAvaroDe rasakzayahetumAha carakaH । ‘rasaSrotaHsu rudDezu svasTAnasTo vidahyate । sa UrdDvaM kAsavegena bahurUpaH pravarttate ॥’ svasTAnasTaH hfdayasTaH । kAsaM vinApi rasakzayo Bavati mArgAvaroDakupitavAtena rasasya SozaRAt । uktaYca । ‘vAyordDAtukzayAt kopo mArgasyAvaraRena ca । anulomakzayaM dfzwvA pratilomakzayAvahaH ॥’ anulomakzayaM darSayitvA pratilomakzayamapyAha । ativyavAyino vA retasi kzIRe pratilomakrameRAnantarA sarvve DAtavo rasaparyyantAH kzIyante । tadyaTA । Sukre kzIRe majjA kzIyate majjani kzIRe'sTi kzIyate । evaM pUrvvaM pUrvvaM kzIyate । nanu kAryyasya Sukrasya kzaye kaTaM kAraRaBUtAnAM majjAdInAM kzayaH । ucyate । SukrakzayAdbAyuH kupyati । yaduktam । ‘vAyorDAtukzayAt kopo mArgasyAvaraRena ceti .’ sa vAyuH sAnniDyakrameRa majjAdIn sarvvAn DAtUn saMSozayati । tatastadanantaraM mAnavaH Suzyati ॥ * ॥ pUrvvarUpamAha । ‘SvAsANgasAdakaPasaMsravatAluSozavamyagnisAdamadapInasakAsanidrAH । Soze Bavizyati Bavanti sa cApi jantuH SuklekzaRo Bavati mAMsaparo riraMsuH ॥ svapnezu kAkaSukaSallakinIlakaRWagfDrAstaTEva kapayaH kfkalAsakASca । taM vAhayanti sa nadIrvijalASca paSyet SuzkAMstarUn pavanaDUmadavArdditAMSca ॥’ * ॥ yakzmaRo lakzaRamAhna । ‘aMsapArSvABitApaSca santApaH karapAdayoH । jvaraH sarvvANgagaSceti lakzaRaM rAjayakzmaRaH ॥’ aMsayoH pArSvayoH aBitApaH pIqA atra sakalaDAtukzayapUrvvakaH sakalaSarIraSozo'pi bodDavyaH । kzIyante DAtavaH sarvve tataH Suzyati mAnava iti saMprApteH । evaM zaqrUpe ekAdaSarUpe ca bodDavyam । etAni trIRi lakzaRAni prAyoBAvitvena carakeRoktAni । suSrutena yakzmaRi zawlakzaRAnyuktAni । ‘Baktadvezo jvaraH kAsaH SvAsaH SoRitadarSanam । svaraBedaSca jAyeta zaqrUpe rAjayakzmaRi ॥’ * ॥ ulvaRatayA dozARAM BedAdekAdaSa lakzaRAnyAha । ‘svaraBedo'nilAcCUlaM saNkocaScAMsapArSvayoH । jvaro dAho'tisAraSca pittAdraktasya cAgamaH ॥ SirasaH paripUrRatvamaBaktacCanda eva ca । kAsaH kaRWasya codDaMso vijYeyaH kaPakopataH ॥’ anilAdulvaRAt evaM pittAt kaPAcca । yata Aha suSrutaH । ‘eka evamataH SozaH sannipAtAtmako gadaH । udrekAttatra liNgAni dozARAM nipatanti ca ॥’ asADyayakzmiRamAha । ‘ekAdaSaBireBirvvA zaqBirvApi samanvitam । triBirvvA pIqitaM liNgErjjvarakAsAsfgAmayEH । jahyAcCozArdditaM jantumicCet suvipulaM yaSaH ॥’ tatra viSezamAha । ‘sarvvErardDEstriBirvvApi liNgErmAMsabalakzaye । yukto varjyaScikitsyastu sarvvarUpo'pyato'nyaTA ॥’ sarvvErliNgErekAdaSaBiH । ardDEH zaqBiH triBirjjvarakAsaruDiravamanEH । ato'nyaTA mAMse bale sati sarvvarUpo'pi pratyAKyAya cikitsyaH । ‘mahASanaM kzIyamARamatIsAranipIqitam । SUnamuzkodaraYcEva yakzmiRaM parivarjayet ॥’ mahASanaM kzIyamARamityekamasADyalakzaRam । atIsAranipIqitamiti dbitIyam । yata uktam । ‘malAyattaM balaM puMsAM SukrAyattantu jIvanam । tasmAdyatnena saMrakzedyakzmiRo malaretasI ॥’ SUnamuzkodaramiti tftIyam ॥ * ॥ arizwamAha । ‘SuklAkzamannadvezwAramUrdDvaSvAsanipIqitam । kfcCreRa bahu mehantaM yakzmA hantIha mAnavam ॥’ mehantaM SukraM kzarantam । SuklAkzatvAdIni ekEkaSo'rizwalakzaRAni ॥ * ॥ avaDimAha । ‘paraM dinasahasrantu yadi jIvati mAnavaH । suBizagBirupakrAntastaruRaH SozapIqitaH ॥’ SozapIqito mAnavaScettaruRo Bavati । suBizagBirupakrAnto Bavati । tadA paraM dinasahasram । dvitIyadinasahasraM yadi jIvati tatra jIvanavikalpa ityarTaH । etena SozapIqito mAnavaScettaruRo Bavati । sadvEdyEScikitsyo Bavati । tadA praTamadinasahasraM jIvedeva ityuktvA cikitsAmAha । ‘jvarAnubanDarahitaM balavantaM kriyAsaham । upakramedAtmavantaM dIptAgnimakfSaM naram ॥’ AtmavantaM yatnavantaM DftimantaM vA ॥ * ॥ aTa nidAnaviSezEH SozaviSezAnAha । ‘vyavAyaSokavArdDakyavyAyAmADvapraSozitAn । vraRoraHkzatasaMjYO ca SoziRO lakzaREH SfRu ॥’ vraRoraHkzatasaMjYO SoziRO । vraRaSozI uraHkzataSozI ca ॥ * ॥ tatra vyavAyaSoziRo lakzaRamAha । ‘vyavAyaSozI Sukrasya kzayaliNgErupadrutaH । pARqudeho yaTApUrvvaM kzIyante cAsya DAtavaH ॥’ Sukrasya kzayaliNgEH suSrutoktEH । tAni yaTA, Sukrakzaye meQravfzaRayorvedanA aSaktirmETune cirAdvA prasekaH praseke cAlpaSukradarSanamiti । yaTApUrvvaM kzIyante cAsya DAtavaH praTamaM SukraM kzIyate paScAt SukrakzayajanitavAyunA majjAdayo'pi DAtavo yaTApUrvvaM kzIyante ॥ * ॥ SokaSoziRo lakzaRamAha । ‘praDyAnaSIlaH srastANgaH SokaSozyapi tAdfSaH । vinA SukrakzayakftErvikArErupalakzitaH ॥’ praDyAnaSIlaH yasyABAvena Soko janitastadDyAnaparaH । srastANgaH SiTilANgaH । tAdfSaH vyavAyaSozisadfSaH । tena SukrAdisarvvaDAtukzayayukto Bavati । paraM SukrakzayakftErvikArErmeQravfzaRavedanAdiBirvarjito Bavati । vyADisvaBAvAt ॥ * ॥ jarASoziRo lakzaRamAha । ‘jarASozI kfzo mandavIryyabudDibalendriyaH । kampano'rucimAn BinnakAMsyapAtrahatasvaraH ॥ zWIvati SlezmaRA hInaM gOravArucipIqitaH । saMprasrutAsyanAsAkzaH SuzkarUkzamalacCaviH ॥’ mandaSabdaH svalpArTaH । SuzkarUkzamalacCaviH SuzkarUkze malacCavI yasya saH ॥ * ॥ aDvaSoziRo lakzaRamAha । ‘aDvapraSozI srastANgaH saMBfzwaparuzacCaviH । prasuptagAtrAvayavaH SuzkaklomagalAnanaH ॥’ saMBfzwasyeva paruzA Caviryasya saH । prasuptagAtrAMvayavaH prasuptaH sparSAjYaH । klomaM tilakaM pipAsAsTAnam ॥ * ॥ vyAyAmaSoziRo lakzaRamAha । ‘vyAyAmaSozI BUyizWameBireva samanvitaH । liNgEruraHkzatakftEH saMyuktaSca kzataM vinA ॥’ eBireva srastANgatvAdiBiraDvaSoziRo lakzaREreva । BUyizWaM atyarTam ॥ * ॥ sanidAnaM vraRaSozamAha । ‘raktakzayAdvedanABistaTEvAhArayantraRAt । vraRitasya BavecCozo yApyo'sADyaSca sa smftaH ॥’ uraHkzatasya nidAnamAha । ‘DanuzAyAsyato'tyarTaM BAramudvahato gurum । yuDyamAnasya baliBiH patato vizamoccataH ॥ vfzaM hayaM vA DAvantaM damyaM cAnyaM । SilA dIrGapAzARaH । aSma prastaraKaRqaH । nirGAto'straviSezaH । vyADiH uraHkzatAKAH ॥ * ॥ uraHkzatasya lakzaRamAha । ‘uro virujyate'tyarTaM Bidyate ca viBajyate । SUlaM Bavati tatpAdaM SuzyatyaNgaM
